title: Marijuana and dreaming
content: I’m curious if any chronic marijuana smokers/edible takers have decided to quit cold turkey and noticed an immediate difference in their dream life ? I am aware that weed disrupts one’s REM cycle and overall natural sleeping patterns but I would be interested in hearing stories. I have been taking an edible in the evening and a few puffs right before bed basically every night for the past year or so. Mostly to destress from the day and increase my appetite since I take medication that makes it near impossible to have an appetite. I’m just on my own little dream journey and would also appreciate any tips for insomnia if that will be a problem when I quit for awhile(: I do drink mugwort, blue pea flower, and Damiana tea a couple nights a week but am not noticing any increase in lucidity… probably because of the weed lol
